text:
Sam D.: need help. newborn paperwork delayed by county. missed 30-day QLE window. can we still add to medical?

Asha (People Ops): Congrats Sam! :tada: Which docs do you already have? hospital birth record? temporary certificate?

Sam D.: hospital discharge summary + the county emailed that cert will be delayed 6-8 weeks. we have baby's passport application receipt and hospital birth certificate (typed hospital form).

Asha (People Ops): Ok commonly carriers will accept supporting docs if the birth certificate is delayed. Typical acceptable bundle: ``
- Hospital birth record or discharge summary
- Passport application receipt or embassy letter if born abroad
- Signed sworn affidavit of birth from parent (we can provide template)
- Birth certificate when it's available (upload later)``
Also note most carriers require submission within 30 days, but they have exception processes for late filings due to government delays. We can request an exception if you submit the bundle and a copy of the county delay notice.

Max (Benefits Ops): Adding: Please upload everything via the benefits portal under "Newborn QLE - Late Docs" and include the county notice text. After we file, carrier response times vary (3-15 business days). If approved retroactive, effective date is usually birth date; otherwise first of next month.

Lina (Payroll): FYI payroll flow: if carrier approves retroactive coverage we'll do a catch-up on next payroll. If not retro, deductions start per carrier effective date. Expect one payroll cycle for the deduction update to show.

Sam D.: uploaded files: "sam_newborn_hospital.pdf", "county_delay_notice.pdf", "passport_receipt.jpg"

Benefits Bot: Upload received from Sam D. - IDs: upload_1918000015, upload_1918000016, upload_1918000017 - Status: awaiting review.

Asha (People Ops): Got uploads. I'll review now. If anything missing I'll DM you. Sam, please redact any SSNs before upload.

Sam D.: redacted SSNs already. thanks.

Max (Benefits Ops): Reviewing now. Preliminary looks ok; I'll submit exception request to carrier with the county notice and hospital form. Will update thread when carrier responds.

Asha (People Ops): If carrier asks for affidavit, here's a quick template we use: ``
I, [Parent Name], declare under penalty of perjury that [Child Name] was born on [date] at [hospital]. I understand that the official birth certificate is delayed and am providing the hospital record and county notice as temporary proof.

Signed: [Parent] Date: [date]``

Sam D.: great — thanks everyone. please keep me posted.

Max (Benefits Ops): Will do. If carrier approves retrospectively, I'll post expected effective date here and ping Lina for payroll adjustments.

Asha (People Ops): Thread update when approved or if carrier needs more docs. :thumbsup:
